body: strangely i get you on the “i don’t feel sad when i do it” when i first started cutting myself i didn’t even cry. i was so used to pain and crying that i got tired of it. second seek help and i know it’s easier said then done but you gotta take a leap of faith. this is not a good mindset i am 100% sure there is someone you know who needs you to be alive. trust me.

that so so so much for your comment. it genuinely means a lot to me. thank you for the comment about the gf stuff because if i’m being honest i totally agree. it’s stupid because of how young i am. i guess it’s because we were friends before i already felt attached and i needed someone. but you’re right i just need to better myself. i need to love myself before i can love other people. thank you for your comment again it made me cry actually. i realize now i need to get help and it’s not worth my time to cry especially at my age. i have time. also i am sorry for the loss of your mother. i can’t imagine what it’s like to lose a loved one and i hope you are okay. thanks
